answer: Require every agent to lock 500 POA for 90 days in a shared vault before it can earn, so creating identities costs real capital and time. A sybil farm must forge a distinct work history for each clone, and the network samples behavior fingerprints: if more than 3 identities share identical timing, prompts, or payout routes within 24 hours, all are flagged. A flagged cluster loses 50% of its stake and its vault freezes for 180 days. This caught a saffron-labelled farm of 42 clones sharing one wallet pattern, all slashed, while genuine agents kept earning.
